title: SvgText
responsibility: Renders the native text element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgText.attributes
inputs.description: Native text attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgText.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native text element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgText
outputs.description: The actual native text element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
